name: Hear Me
description: The life of high school student Ekim, who lives in a humble neighborhood, is shaken by a tragic event that takes place in front of her eyes: her best friend Leyla is injured in a hit-and-run accident. The car disappears inside a prestigious private school, attended by the richest kids of the city. When the neighbors demand justice, the school tries to bury the news by giving scholarships to three studious teenagers from the neighborhood. Ekim, Bekir and Ayşe are chosen, but they soon realize that their life is about to get harder. Yet, Ekim has no intention of letting this go quietly, and there is one thing she is sure of: the criminal is one of the students. While she tries to uncover this dark secret and ensure justice, she will be troubled by her emotions as her heart is turned upside down.

videos.title: Hear Me (1)
videos.overview: The life of high school student Ekim, who lives an ordinary life in one of the middle-class neighborhoods of Istanbul, is turned upside down by a tragic traffic accident that takes place in front of her eyes. The only thing that she remembers about the accident is the mask on the driver's face and her friend Leyla lying on the ground covered in blood. The car that hit Leyla and fled, sparked a rebellion from the neighborhood as soon as they learned it was hiding at the Gerçek High School. The school administration tries to soften the reactions by giving scholarships to three successful young people from the neighborhood. However, Ekim has no intention of forgetting about the accident. The culprit is one of the rich and spoiled children at school. While Ekim struggles to ensure justice, her emotions will confuse her and her heart will be turned upside down. The wind of youth will blow so hard and so fiercely that nothing will ever be the same at Gerçek High School...

videos.title: Hear Me (2)
videos.overview: After finding the mask in Kanat's locker, Ekim asks Selçuk for help, telling him that it was Kanat who hit Leyla. Selcuk's questioning of Kanat not only brings Aziz face to face with his father Rıza, but also escalates the tension in the family. Kanat intimidates Ekim through Bekir to prevent her attempts to reveal the truth. Things don't go well for Ayşe either : her father's punishment makes the situation worse. The tension between Melisa and Ekim is also increasing. Melisa, angry at the possibility of Kanat getting closer to Ekim, makes various moves to eliminate her. On the other hand, Ekim is caught up in very ugly game as a result of her connection with Kanat. The people at the school decide to give a heavy sentence to Ekim and Bekir for this crime.

videos.title: Hear Me (3)
videos.overview: Even though the bullying they experience upsets Ekim and Bekir, Ekim is determined to stand up again and fight the bad guys. Meanwhile, the helping hand reaching out to them surprises everyone. As Kanat gets confused, teacher Selim's suspicions about what is happening at school are increasing. Someone obtains footage of Ekim, which falls into Melisa hands. This will once again upset the balance at school. While trying to deal with the bullies at Gerçek High School, Ekim tries to make up with her best friend Leyla. But Leyla's anger and a move she made on social media draw attention to the accident again. As secrets begin to emerge, an unexpected event happens at the party where Ekim goes to get to know the people at school better. Ekim will definitely say stop to bullying this time.

videos.title: Impossible Love
videos.overview: Kanat suddenly kissing Ekim and what happens after that raises a lot of questions. A surprising person will save Ekim from the forest. When Melisa questions Kanat about that night, Ekim reveals everything. This time it's Melisa's turn to go crazy with anger. Is it a game, as Kanat explained, or part of the truth? On the other hand, it is now Emine's turn to be the victim of school bullying. But this time, there is a strong person against the bullies: Teacher Selim! With Bahar, he finds a petition at school that finally lifts the veil of secrecy. While all this is happening, an unexpected person visits Leyla which pushes her to take the first steps to return to school. Ekim has mixed feelings. Still, she does not deviate from her purpose. She decides to play a game that will unmask everyone. But when something unpredicted happens, she is beaten at her own game...and Leyla is there to witness it all.

videos.title: For Love
videos.overview: The game that Ekim set up to unmask the bullies is jeopardized when her photo with Kanat is published. With Ekim losing at her own game, and Leyla seeing the photo, distance grows between the two friends. While Ekim and Kanat search separately for the person who published the photo, Leyla is angry with both of them. The public release of the photo pits Melisa even more against Ekim. With the information Ozan received from Bekir, they discover Ekim's soft spot. They plan to hit her where she least expects it. Ekim sees someone unexpected next to the bullies. As Bahar and Selim continue to fight the bullying at school, Bahar begins to feel helpless and useless. Selim becomes her biggest supporter to get rid of these feelings and stop blaming herself. While everyone is at war at Gerçek High School, Aziz is on the sidelines, trying to set up another game that causes Ekim to learn a shocking truth about Kanat.

videos.title: My Last Word
videos.overview: Ekim has fallen into the trap set by Aziz. The thought that Kanat could harm Leyla really upsets her. Will she be able to tell her the truth she learned? On the other hand, Leyla has opened a new chapter in her life by going to Gerçek High School, which she thinks she deserves. Next to Melisa, who she thinks is her friend, there is Ekim, whom she once considered her best friend but is now her enemy. Moreover, she thinks that Kanat is in love with her. While Leyla is lost in these thoughts, Kanat admits to Ekim that he loves her. As secrets are revealed one by one, another tragedy occurs in Kanat's house. Teacher Bahar will unwittingly confront everyone with a reality. Teacher Selim, on the other hand, tries a different strategy to protect his students from the pain of his own past. He writes “Bullying Court" on the class board as a lesson topic. The students sit on the chairs shown to them, not knowing what they will encounter. The students will have to make a decision.

videos.title: For The Sake of Love
videos.overview: Kanat's accident shook everyone deeply. After receiving the news, Ekim fears losing Kanat for the first time and confronts the feelings she had hidden inside. Even though Ekim is troubled by her feelings, there is one thing that she cannot overlook: Leyla! Aware of this fact, Kanat decides to make a move that will completely change the situation. There is another person who is deeply shaken by Kanat's return from the dead. Suna makes a radical and dangerous decision to protect her family. The police make an important discovery regarding the accident. Melisa and Ozan learn about the video Halil shot on the day of the accident and make a plan to get it from him. While Melisa and Ozan are dealing with Halil, there is someone who sets up a much bigger game. Fikret will put an end to the accident issue with his plan and will save his own skin. But since every game has a winner and a loser, this game also will also make a victim.

videos.title: Don't Leave Me
videos.overview: Kanat's arrest has taken many people by surprise at Gerçek High School. While Leyla thinks that Ekim is the cause of this incident and blames her, Ekim believes Kanat is innocent. The police refer to the statement of another person from the school. Leyla is shaken by the fact that the person she has been messaging until now is not Kanat. After collecting herself and confronting Aziz, she takes a new decision. Now she has a new goal. After Kanat is taken away by the police, the students are divided into two. The bullying against Ekim, Bekir, and Ayşe increases. But this time, Bekir will not remain silent either. Selim and Bahar decide who is responsible for what happened at Gerçek High School and make a plan. They will stop this order. They take action to complete the work that Ziya left unfinished. For this, they need the help of several students.

videos.title: One More Day
videos.overview: Ekim is at an important crossroads. She has two options to get out of the difficult situation she is in. Either she will sacrifice herself and save her friend, or she will watch her friend's life be ruined. She makes a decision. Leyla is now officially fighting against her best friend among the bullies. Ekim wants to take one last day for herself before admitting defeat and retreating. But with Melisa's unexpected move, her happiness is left unfinished. While Selim and Bahar continue to work for the inspector who comes to the school to stop the bullying, Fikret does his best to prevent them. When Selim and Bahar seek help from Ekim, they encounter an unexpected attitude. Kanat tries to understand the reason for the change in Ekim, but fails. In the end, Hazal helps him. When Kanat finds out about the incident, he makes a plan not to lose Ekim. While the relationship between the two has improved, a big surprise awaits them at school.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Kanat and Ekim's arrival together created a bombshell effect at school. Melisa goes crazy at this sight. The fact that everyone learns that the two are lovers threatens Melisa's reputation. While the girls think that Melisa is not as strong as she used to be, Melisa blames Ekim for everything. She devises a grand plan to pull Kanat back. On the other hand, the happiest day of Leyla, who announced that she could walk to everyone at school, turned into a nightmare, and the distance between her and Ekim turned into an abyss. Even though this situation hurts Ekim, she has to remain silent for the sake of her main goal. While she uses an important information she acquired to achieve her grand plan, she will take the biggest blow from her friend for whom she sacrificed herself. Even though it hurts, Ekim will continue to walk on the path she thinks is right. In this road, the obstacle in front of her will be the person she loves the most.
